source.title: Newry Reporter, 21 May 1964, p. 1 ("Kilkeel Rural Council: nominations")
source.publisher: Newry Reporter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Nominations read on the page image of the Newry Reporter, 21 May 1964, p. 1 (continued p. 10).

note: Triennial election of Kilkeel rural district council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964 where contested. Sixteen divisions (Greencastle no longer listed); fourteen had a single candidate after withdrawals and disqualifications (Lisnacree and Dunnaman among them, Newry Telegraph, 23 May 1964, p. 13). Attical and Maghera were polled; their results are recorded from the Irish News, 5 June 1964, p. 1. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. New member, replacing Michael Grant, who retired. Returned unopposed.
